definition: A numerical cross-branch bridge is eligible only when exact required identity keys, scientific artifact lineage, frame semantics and quantity semantics are all compatible and the relevant numerical quantity was actually measured on both sides.
The downstream method explicitly consumes or depends on the upstream layer, but this project has not established a compatible measured numerical transfer coefficient/value.
A real upstream/downstream relationship exists, but release, event frame, artifact lineage or method scope is not exactly matched.
Branches can be aligned by source/release/artifact identity, but no dependence magnitude or directional transfer is established.
A desired bridge is scientifically meaningful but cannot be evaluated because required public assets are absent/inadequate under the frozen branch boundary.
A desired bridge is blocked because the public representation/schema cannot support an unambiguous compatible quantity.

A difference/dependence is observed or structurally plausible, but this project cannot attribute it to one unique upstream cause because multiple dimensions are confounded or no controlled intervention exists.
